Name: EasyChests - Portable Categorized Warehouse
Author: lljxww
Description:
[center][size=6][b]EasyChests[/b][/size]
[size=4]Portable Categorized Warehouse[/size]
By lljxww | Version 0.17.0 | English / 简体中文[/center]

Spend less time moving items between chests. Press [b]G[/b] to open a shared warehouse, press [b]V[/b] to sort your backpack into categories, and use stored materials for crafting, cooking and tool upgrades.

[b]Single-player only. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.1.10+. Automate and Generic Mod Config Menu are optional.[/b]

[size=4][b]A warehouse that grows with your farm[/b][/size]
EasyChests provides [b]88 ordinary storage categories[/b], organized under ten navigation groups plus an All view. Four categories are available initially; unlock the others with gold from the warehouse menu.

Storage expands as needed, with [b]72-slot pages[/b] and no configured capacity limit. Favorite categories stay in a separate column, and you can hide unlocked empty categories. A separate item bookmark view makes frequently used items easier to find.

The 0.17.0 interface uses warm cream surfaces, green primary actions, larger category labels and clearer selected states. Category cards and dialog help accommodate English and Simplified Chinese text.

[size=4][b]Deposit, find and restock[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Quick deposit:[/b] press V to sort backpack items into their storage categories. Common tools, warehouse terminals and items marked Carry All are skipped; numeric carry targets keep the requested amount.[/*]
[*][b]Carry targets:[/b] select an item and open Carry to keep a chosen backpack quantity across all qualities. Deposits move only the surplus. Refill Carry retrieves available stock from ordinary warehouse storage.[/*]
[*][b]Optional auto-deposit:[/b] when at most one purchased backpack slot is free, archive eligible items automatically. Off by default; it does not sell items.[/*]
[*][b]Global search:[/b] search by item name, qualified ID or category name. Results reference real warehouse stacks, so you can withdraw, ship or jump to the source category.[/*]
[*][b]Processing filters:[/b] find ingredients for wine/brewing, preserves, juice, pickles, drying or fish smoking. Filters change the view, without moving the items.[/*]
[*][b]Organization:[/b] organize a category or the warehouse, and keep gaps compacted without changing the order during ordinary gap compaction.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Craft directly from storage[/b][/size]
Ordinary warehouse materials are available to [b]vanilla crafting, cooking and Clint's tool upgrades[/b]. Crafting access is enabled by default and can be disabled in configuration. You do not need a physical terminal for these uses. Tool upgrades still require the actual tool, gold and normal upgrade conditions.

Place valuables in [b]Protected Storage[/b] to exclude them from automatic material consumption. They remain searchable and can be withdrawn or shipped manually. Bookmarks, carry targets and machine reserves serve different purposes: bookmarks help you find items; carry targets govern backpack deposits and restocking; machine reserves govern Automate inputs. None is a general ban on manual use or shipping.

[size=4][b]Optional Automate integration[/b][/size]
Buy a [b]Portable Warehouse Terminal for 2,500g[/b] in the menu and place it in an Automate machine network. Multiple terminals access the same warehouse; removing a terminal does not delete warehouse stock.

Select an item and open [b]Machines[/b] to allow or block supported machines, and use [b]Machine Reserve[/b] to keep a minimum warehouse quantity away from Automate. For example, allow Keg and block Preserves Jar for starfruit to permit automatic wine production while preventing jam production from warehouse stock.

Supported machines are allowed by default. Permissions and reserves are shared across qualities of the same item. These settings affect warehouse Automate inputs; they do not restrict manual processing or crafting. Third-party custom Automate factories may need separate integration.

[size=4][b]Shipping[/b][/size]
Use the Shipping Bin view or [b]Alt + left-click[/b] to move a shippable stack into the farm's native shipping bin. On Mac, use [b]Option + left-click[/b]. Items ship overnight and can be retrieved before then. Automatic deposit never sells items.

[size=4][b]Installation and updating[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.10+ for Stardew Valley 1.6.15+.[/*]
[*]Close the game and back up your save.[/*]
[*]Extract EasyChests-0.17.0.zip into the game's Mods folder. Check that Mods/EasyChests contains manifest.json and EasyChests.dll.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, load a single-player save and press G.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] 2.6.1+ for machine integration; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.12.0+ for in-game configuration.

When updating, keep your own config.json and replace the mod files. Install only one copy of EasyChests. Warehouse IDs remain unchanged. Chests Anywhere, Bigger Backpack and StardewHack are not required.

[size=4][b]Language and controls[/b][/size]
[b]English is the default.[/b] Open the category picker and click its top-right language button to switch to Simplified Chinese immediately and save the choice. You can also use GMCM or set Language to "en" or "zh-CN" in config.json while the game is closed. Item names, machine names and descriptions supplied by the game or other mods follow their own language resources.

[list]
[*]G: open the warehouse / return through menus. V: deposit backpack items.[/*]
[*]Left-click: select. Ctrl + left-click: quick transfer.[/*]
[*]Shift + left-click: pick up a stack in ordinary storage; locate the original stack in search/bookmark/filter views. Right-click: split stacks in ordinary storage.[/*]
[*]Alt/Option + left-click: ship a full stack.[/*]
[*]Left/Right or Tab/Shift+Tab: switch categories when no text box has focus.[/*]
[*]Mouse wheel, PageUp/PageDown or page buttons: change pages. Scroll over the backpack to access additional purchased slots.[/*]
[*]Ctrl+F: focus search. Enter: apply the active input. Esc: return through dialogs, input focus and views.[/*]
[*]Hold Shift while viewing an item tooltip: expand protection explanations.[/*]
[/list]Keybindings and options can be changed through GMCM or config.json.

[size=4][b]FAQ and compatibility[/b][/size]
[b]Does this enlarge my backpack or ordinary chests?[/b]
No. It provides separate warehouse storage. Purchased Bigger Backpack slots are supported; it does not grant extra slots.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer or with a controller?[/b]
Multiplayer and controller navigation are not supported. Use a single-player save and keyboard/mouse.

[b]What happens to items from other mods?[/b]
Unrecognized items go to the miscellaneous/mod-items category. This does not guarantee compatibility with every custom machine, item behavior or crafting framework. Frameworks that bypass vanilla APIs may require separate integration.

[b]Can I add it to an existing save?[/b]
Yes. Back up your save first. Warehouse items and settings persist with normal game saves; save before quitting to retain your changes.

[b]How do I uninstall?[/b]
Withdraw stored items, recover placed terminals and save before removing the mod. Uninstalling does not return warehouse items to your backpack.

[size=4][b]Testing and support[/b][/size]
0.17.0 passed Release compilation, 146,394 logic assertions, eight localization/packaging tests and runtime audits against actual game assemblies under .NET 6. English and Chinese category and carry-dialog previews were checked using real game fonts and drawing code in an isolated renderer. The author's earlier Apple Silicon Mac mini playtest covered 0.15.0. Full 0.17.0 in-game acceptance, Windows/Linux interactive testing and long-session stress testing remain unconfirmed.

For a bug report, include your operating system, game/SMAPI/EasyChests versions, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Remove personal information before sharing logs or screenshots.

[center][size=6][b]EasyChests · 便携分类仓库[/b][/size]
[size=4]随时存取，分类归档，直接使用仓库材料[/size]
作者 lljxww | 版本 0.17.0 | English / 简体中文[/center]

减少往返箱子搬运物品的时间。按 [b]G[/b] 打开共享仓库，按 [b]V[/b] 将背包物品分类入库；制作、烹饪和升级工具时，直接使用仓库材料。

[b]仅支持单人存档。需要星露谷物语 1.6.15+ 与 SMAPI 4.1.10+。Automate 和 Generic Mod Config Menu 为可选依赖。[/b]

[size=4][b]随农场逐步成长的仓库[/b][/size]
提供 [b]88 个普通存储分类[/b]，按十个大分类导航，另有“全部分类”总览。初始开放四类，其余可在仓库界面使用金币解锁。

每页 [b]72 格[/b]，存储按需扩容，没有配置容量上限。收藏分类在左侧独立展示，可隐藏已解锁的空分类；物品也能单独收藏，方便集中查找。

0.17.0 使用暖纸色面板、绿色主要操作、更大的分类文字和更清晰的选中状态。分类卡片与弹窗说明兼顾英文和简体中文排版。

[size=4][b]归档、查找与补齐随身[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]一键归档：[/b]按 V 将背包物品存入对应分类，跳过常用工具、仓库终端及“全部随身”物品；设置数字随身目标后，只存入超额部分。[/*]
[*][b]随身目标：[/b]选中物品，打开“随身”设置背包保留数量，跨品质合计。“补齐随身”可从普通仓库库存补足目标。[/*]
[*][b]可选自动入库：[/b]背包已购买格子剩余不超过一格时，自动归档符合条件的物品。默认关闭，不会自动出售物品。[/*]
[*][b]全仓搜索：[/b]按物品名、限定 ID 或分类名查找。结果对应真实库存，可直接取出、出货或定位到原分类。[/*]
[*][b]加工用途筛选：[/b]查找可酿酒、做果酱、榨汁、腌制、烘干或熏鱼的原料。筛选只改变视图，不移动物品。[/*]
[*][b]整理库存：[/b]支持整理当前分类或全仓；普通补空位操作保持原有物品顺序。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]直接使用仓库材料[/b][/size]
普通仓库材料可用于[b]原版制作、烹饪及克林特工具升级[/b]，无需先取出，也无需放置终端。仓库制作材料功能默认开启，可在配置中关闭。升级工具仍需携带工具本体，并满足原版金币及升级条件。

不想被自动消耗的物品，可手动放入[b]“不消耗”分类[/b]。其中物品仍可搜索、手动取出或出货。

几种设置的作用不同：物品收藏方便查找；随身目标控制背包归档及补齐；机器保留量控制 Automate 取料。它们都不是对手动使用或出货的全面保护。

[size=4][b]可选 Automate 自动化[/b][/size]
在仓库界面花费 [b]2,500 金购买共享终端[/b]，放入 Automate 机器网络即可接入库存。多个终端共享同一仓库，拆除终端不会删除仓库物品。

选中物品后打开[b]“机器操作”[/b]，逐项允许或禁止机器；通过[b]“机器保留”[/b]设置最低保留数量。例如选中杨桃，允许“小桶”、禁止“罐头瓶”，就能让仓库杨桃自动酿酒，同时避免被用于制作果酱。

默认允许全部支持的机器。同一物品的各品质共用机器权限和保留量；这些设置只限制仓库的 Automate 进料，不限制手动加工和制作。第三方自定义 Automate 工厂可能需要额外适配。

[size=4][b]快捷出货[/b][/size]
通过“出货箱”视图，或按 [b]Alt+左键[/b] 将可出货物品整堆移入农场原生出货箱。Mac 使用 [b]Option+左键[/b]。物品过夜结算，过夜前可取回。归档和自动入库不会出售物品。

[size=4][b]安装与更新[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]为星露谷物语 1.6.15+ 安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.10+。[/*]
[*]退出游戏并备份存档。[/*]
[*]将 EasyChests-0.17.0.zip 解压到游戏 Mods 目录，确认 Mods/EasyChests 下存在 manifest.json 和 EasyChests.dll。[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏，载入单人存档后按 G。[/*]
[/list]可选：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] 2.6.1+ 提供机器集成；[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.12.0+ 提供游戏内配置。

更新时保留自己的 config.json，替换模组文件，并确保只安装一份 EasyChests。升级保持库存 ID 不变。无需安装 Chests Anywhere、Bigger Backpack 或 StardewHack。

[size=4][b]语言与快捷键[/b][/size]
[b]默认英文，可切换简体中文。[/b]展开分类面板，点击右上角语言按钮，即时切换并保存；也可使用 GMCM，或退出游戏后将 config.json 的 Language 设为 "en" 或 "zh-CN"。游戏或其他模组提供的物品名称、机器名称及说明沿用其自身语言资源。

[list]
[*]G：打开仓库／逐层返回；V：归档背包。[/*]
[*]左键：选中；Ctrl+左键：快捷存取。[/*]
[*]Shift+左键：普通库存中拾起整堆，搜索／收藏／筛选视图中定位原库存；右键：普通库存中拆分。[/*]
[*]Alt/Option+左键：整堆出货。[/*]
[*]左右方向键或 Tab/Shift+Tab：没有文本框焦点时切换分类。[/*]
[*]滚轮、PageUp/PageDown 或分页按钮：翻页；在背包区域滚动可访问更多已购买格子。[/*]
[*]Ctrl+F：聚焦搜索；Enter：应用当前输入；Esc：逐层关闭弹窗、退出输入与视图。[/*]
[*]查看物品悬停提示时按住 Shift：展开完整保护规则。[/*]
[/list]快捷键与选项可通过 GMCM 或 config.json 修改。

[size=4][b]常见问题与兼容性[/b][/size]
[b]会扩大背包或普通箱子吗？[/b]
不会。本模组提供独立仓库，支持 Bigger Backpack 已购买的格子，但不会赠送额外背包容量。

[b]支持联机和手柄吗？[/b]
暂不支持联机或手柄导航。请使用单人存档和键盘鼠标。

[b]其他模组的物品放在哪里？[/b]
无法识别分类的物品会进入“待分类与模组物品”。这不代表兼容所有自定义机器、物品行为和制作框架；绕过原版 API 的框架可能需要额外适配。

[b]能加入已有存档吗？[/b]
可以，建议先备份。仓库物品和设置随正常游戏存档保存，退出前请保存游戏。

[b]如何卸载？[/b]
先取出仓库物品、回收已放置终端并保存，再移除模组。卸载不会将仓库物品自动退回背包。

[size=4][b]测试与反馈[/b][/size]
0.17.0 已通过 Release 编译、146,394 项逻辑断言、8 项本地化／打包测试及真实游戏程序集下的 .NET 6 运行时审计。中英文分类面板和随身设置弹窗已用真实游戏字体与绘制代码生成独立预览并检查。作者此前在 Apple Silicon Mac mini 上的游戏内测试对应 0.15.0；0.17.0 完整游戏内验收、Windows/Linux 交互和长时间压力测试尚未确认。

反馈时请提供操作系统、游戏／SMAPI／EasyChests 版本、复现步骤及 [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI 日志链接[/url]。分享日志或截图前请移除个人信息。
